description.p: Northstar is a clean-room web browser written from scratch in C, with a GTK 4 user interface and a libcurl network stack. It is built to be small, secure, and readable by a single person end to end.

ul.li: A from-scratch HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript engine — no forked browser engine.
One window, one page, one process: the page engine runs in the shell process behind a seccomp + Landlock syscall sandbox on Linux.
No JIT, which keeps the JavaScript attack surface small.
No telemetry: it does not phone home and does not track the user.
Dynamic :has() selectors update after class, attribute and child-list mutations.
Percentage and elliptical border-radius resolve against the border box, so circular avatars are round.
Relative colour syntax, the color() function and one shared parser for all six colour functions.
Text is itemized, shaped and broken by ns-pango, which caches finished glyph strings across layouts.
The DOM insertion methods run the insertion steps, and getComputedStyle resolves every property it enumerates.
SVG is rendered by the engine instead of librsvg, so page stylesheets reach inside inline icons.
<video> plays MPEG-1, decoded in-tree, and responds to play, pause, currentTime, duration and readyState.
Animated PNG plays, and lossy WebP decodes through the memory-safe path.
gdk-pixbuf no longer decodes page images, so the set of decoders reachable from a web page is fixed at build time.
Square borders are painted inside the border box rather than centred on its edge.
Fixed an out-of-bounds read in the vendored MPEG-1 decoder, found by fuzzing.

description.p: Debian packaging and portability release, adding Debian 13 and sid CI builds.
Stability release fixing two memory-corruption bugs found with AddressSanitizer on live sites.

ul.li: Fixed a use-after-free when a page dropped its IntersectionObserver while the observer callback was running.
Fixed JS class-ID collisions between page sessions that ran the wrong finalizer on the wrong object, causing random crashes after navigating.
Dropdown (select) controls render their chosen option again, and native checkboxes no longer draw doubled with author CSS decorations.
Fixed a heap-corruption crash when closing the browser after using the bookmarks popover.
Updated the vendored Wuffs image decoders and the WAMR WebAssembly interpreter (CVE-2026-54913 loader fix).
New about:start splash artwork; refreshed Debian/RPM packaging; new Alpine (musl) and macOS CI builds.

description.p: Initial release of the Northstar GPL edition: a single-window, single-process desktop browser for Linux and Windows.
